## Delivery Note

**ITEM:** S4c-A1, the Injured status art (**samples**), from `drafts/planning/S4c-injured-status.md` (#120). Folder: `incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/`. Everything is generated by script (`source/make_injured.py`, `source/make_injured_preview.py`). No blood, bones, cracks or red. Gentle and hopeful: a plaster sticker, soft stars and a cosy pop-up.

**WHAT:**
- **Overlay sheets for each character** (`sprites/<char>/<char>_<layer>_<anim>.png`). Each has the same frame size, 8-direction rows and frame columns as that character's own sheets, so they share its anchor.
  - **player** (128×160): `idle`, `walk`, `hit`
  - **swarmer, shield, brute, padded (Bouncy Bopper):** `idle`, `move`, `windup`
  - **keeper:** `idle`, `move`, `windup_slam`, `windup_sweep`
- **Layers:** `injured-stars-back` goes under the character; `injured-bandage` and `injured-stars-front` go over it. Three stars (soft yellow and warm white, with a gold-brown outline) circle the top of the head, passing behind and in front of it. A cartoon plaster cross sits on the forehead corner, away from the eyes.
- **Wind-up fade (code rule, `sprites/injured.json` → `windupFade`):** during a wind-up the star layers drop to **50%** alpha over 4 ticks and come back after it. The bandage stays at full strength. The S11 tell is untouched. The preview shows the fade across each enemy's wind-up.
- **Wobble (code rule, `wobble`):** ±3° around the ground point, 1.6 s period, in idle and move only. It stops during a wind-up.
- **"Shake it off" puff:** `sprites/fx/injured-puff_shake-off.png`, 8 frames at 128×128 and 16 fps, ground point 64,104.96. A cream cloud ring with two little stars popping away. Played on `injuredEnd`.
- **"Injured!" pop-up:** `sprites/fx/injured-popup_plate.png` (176×56), a cream pill with a bandage icon and **no text baked in**. The game writes **"Injured!"** in its UI font in `textArea` (`#5a3e22`). It shows once when Injured starts: pop in, hold, float up and fade over 0.9 s. The preview shows it with the word set in Nunito Black.
- `sprites/injured.json` has the draw order, colours, files, fps and these rules.

- [scene 1x](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-4-scene-1x.png), [scene at phone width, 390 px](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/review-4-scene-phone-390px.png)
- Greyscale: [player](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/greyscale-1-player-8-directions-2x.png), [enemies](https://github.com/Ingy372/Dojo-game/blob/bot-art-s4c/incoming-art/status-injured-s4c/preview/greyscale-2-enemies-idle-then-windup-fade-2x.png)

**Second pass:**
- The head finder snapped onto raised arms and the staff in wind-ups. The head is now taken from the idle pose and moved with the body's centre.
- The player's bandage covered an eye. It's now on the forehead corner, smaller.
- The stars were 20% too small at phone size, so I made them bigger.
- Checked greyscale: the stars and sticker are light with a dark outline, so they stay readable without colour.

**DECIDE / FLAGS:**
1. **Player or enemies?** The request said "on the player", but the spec says **enemies** get Injured (S4c-A1 done-when: "all 5 enemies plus Bouncy Bopper"), and the player has no wind-up. I made both: the player sheets and all 6 enemies. Should the player ever be Injured? If not, the player sheets can be dropped.
2. **Wording:** "Injured!" is the spec's **decided** word (Decided #3), not a placeholder. S4c-C1 (Content) still owns the final text. It's not baked into the art, so it can be translated.
3. **Stars at the head:** the spec asks for stars "circling its head", which bends our "nothing above heads" rule. The orbit sits on the top of the head and rises at most about 6 px above it. OK?
4. **Bosses at half strength:** use the same art, or fewer stars (2) for Guardians and the Keeper?
5. **Font in the preview:** Nunito (OFL) is used only to mock the word in the preview; it isn't in the sprites.

**NEXT:** Programmer (S4c-P1): draw the layers while `injuredTicks > 0`, apply the fade and wobble rules, the pop-up on `injured`, the puff on `injuredEnd`. Tester (S4c-T1): check readability on a real phone.
